constraints: By default this command decodes the document using UTF-8 (USE CHARACTER SET can change this).
Field/variable assignment is positional by front-to-back layering order of objects on the current input form, not by name; the input form must contain no buttons, and subform objects are ignored.
Default field/record delimiters (tab / carriage return) come from the FldDelimit/RecDelimit system variables and can be reassigned before the call.
